Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

C. I. D.
H. O. P...
No. 581
D. 18. 9 16

September 15th 1916

Sir,
Tsang Sz Zung 張士衡 the official who has been conducting the trial of the three Manchu Restoration party prisoners at the Arsenal left for Nanking yesterday to consult with Feng Kou Chang regarding the removal of the prisoners to Peking for trial.
It is reported that in consequence of the increasing activity of the Manchu Restoration Party in the Yangtse valley, General Yang yesterday received a telegram from Peking instructing him that he will be held personally responsible should there be any outbreak in the places under his jurisdiction. General Yang proposes to transfer troops from Sungkiang and Fung-ching to fill the vacancies in the vicinity of the Arsenal.
The dissatisfaction of the rebels with the working of the repatriation scheme is increasing and it is feared that some of them may be induced to join the Manchu restoration party.
About 20 skilled workmen have left the Arsenal and it is reported that they have been engaged to go to France for work there.
General Tsai Ao 蔡鍔 has left the Paulun Hospital and his present whereabouts are being kept secret as he does not wish to see visitors nor receive correspondence until he has recovered from his illness.
It is reported that Han Hwei 韓恢 has offered the master painters to settle the painters strike for $3,000. The strike is still on.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmmmstons
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：KPD 15/9）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

刑事侦缉处
H. O. P...
第 581 号
D. 18. 9 16

1916年9月15日

先生：

负责在兵工厂审理三名满清复辟党囚犯的官员张士衡（Tsang Sz Zung）昨日前往南京，就将其移送北京受审一事与冯国璋（Feng Kou Chang）进行磋商。

据悉，鉴于满清复辟党在长江流域的活动日益频繁，杨将军昨日收到来自北京的电报，指示若其管辖区域内发生任何暴动，他将承担个人责任。杨将军拟从松江和奉贤调遣部队，以填补兵工厂附近的防务空缺。

叛乱分子对遣返方案实施情况的不满情绪日益加剧，令人担忧其中一些人可能会被诱使加入满清复辟党。

约有20名熟练工匠已离开兵工厂，据报他们已被雇佣前往法国工作。

蔡锷（Tsai Ao）将军已离开宝隆医院，目前其行踪保密，因他不愿在病愈前会见访客或接收信件。

据报，韩恢（Han Hwei）已向画家行会首领出价3,000美元，以解决画家罢工事件。罢工仍在继续。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmmmstons
总探长

（批：KPD 9月15日）
